$comment: Machine-readable codebase knowledge graph for agents. Validated by tests/unit/knowledge-graph.test.ts on every test run: files must exist, exports must exist, edges must reference known nodes, and every top-level src/ directory must be owned by exactly one node. Read docs/knowledge-graph/README.md first.

nodes.label: Config & capability gates
nodes.purpose: Single env-parsed config. Every mutation capability is a fail-closed boolean flag read through getConfig(); tests isolate flags via tests/helpers/fillEnvIsolation.ts.

key_files.src/config/env.ts: zod-style env schema; loads repo `.env` as source of truth (override leftover shell vars); flag defaults (all false)

nodes.label: Storage (SQLite + artifacts)
nodes.purpose: SQLite (data/) is the source of truth for application state. Atomic JSON writers for artifacts/. Outcome recorders feed the improvement loop.

nodes.label: Logging & redaction
nodes.purpose: Structured JSON logger; redaction scrubs secrets/PII before anything is persisted or printed.

nodes.label: Queue & state machine
nodes.purpose: Application lifecycle (docs/state-machine.md). ALL status changes go through transitionApplication — never ad-hoc writes. Review items are the human-work queue; advisory items do not freeze an app. Automation runs hold the atomic unattended-submission budget.

key_files.src/queue/automationRuns.ts: arm rows; tryConsumeUnattendedSubmission is ONE atomic conditional UPDATE

nodes.label: Jobs repository
nodes.purpose: Job rows (JobRight postings) + fingerprint dedupe. jobs.raw_json carries employer_application_url once navigation resolves it.

nodes.label: Browser sessions & auth
nodes.purpose: The ONLY allowed chromium.launch sites (house rule): serviceSession, loginFlow, fixtureSession. CDP_ATTACH connects to the operator's own Chrome and close() only disconnects — never closes their tabs.

key_files.src/browser/fixtureSession.ts: withFixtureHtmlPage / withPublicUrlPage / openPublicUrlSession (pipeline --submit holds the fill browser for the click)

nodes.label: JobRight ingress
nodes.purpose: Discovery (feed -> SQLite), job-detail inspection, resume download, materials registration, and the on-page primitives navigation uses (Apply click, interstitial handling, closed-posting detection). All jobs enter here — provenance is the trust model.

key_files.src/jobright/discoveryRun.ts: runJobRightDiscovery — feed to QUEUED apps; fails loud on empty feed
key_files.src/jobright/enqueueJobs.ts: enqueue by id; validates employer URL at ingestion
key_files.src/jobright/navigateToEmployer.ts: Apply click + popup capture (settledPopupUrl waits out about:blank), customize-resume interstitial: PROCEED never X
key_files.src/jobright/selectors/v1.ts: versioned JobRight selectors (house rule: selectors live in registries)
key_files.src/jobright/extension/selectors.ts: JobRight browser-extension selector registry (autofillTrigger ships empty until ext-capture promotes; presence markers for the preflight DOM probe)
key_files.src/jobright/extension/autofill.ts: attemptExtensionAutofill — clicks only promoted trigger selectors, value-fingerprint settle detection, bounded
key_files.src/jobright/extension/capture.ts: headed ext-capture: operator activates, before/after diff + selector candidates, classed values only

nodes.label: Navigation (employer-URL resolution)
nodes.purpose: Phases: A read anchor hrefs (zero mutation) -> B click Apply, capture popup/same-tab -> C browser-use agent via CDP. Congruence (company vs URL) is EVIDENCE recorded on the report, not a gate (operator directive 2026-08-14); duplicates among LIVE apps park. Walls: auth/captcha/phone_otp/budget/agent_unavailable/closed/duplicate_url.

key_files.src/navigation/congruence.ts: extractOrgCandidates/checkUrlCongruence + duplicate detection (dead states never block)
key_files.src/navigation/candidateLinks.ts: href ranking; looksLikeApplicationUrl; ATS sibling hosts
key_files.src/navigation/auditEmployerUrls.ts: offline sweep: repairs poisoned URLs, parks duplicates

nodes.label: browser-use agent sidecar
nodes.purpose: Python sidecar (agent/jobright_agent/navigate.py) over stdin/stdout JSON, attached to the operator's CDP Chrome. Node side validates every result: a supported-ATS host is always an acceptable landing place; acceptance is adapter validation + recorded congruence.

nodes.label: ATS adapters
nodes.purpose: One adapter per vendor (greenhouse/lever/ashby/workable/workday) + GENERIC for any https employer form (no flag — operator directive 2026-08-14; trust is provenance). detectAtsFromUrl dispatches vendor-first, generic last. HTML detectAts never returns unsupported for a fillable page — unmatched hosts and form-less SPAs use generic. Shared pre-mutation gate requires trusted host + no login wall + no captcha + form markers + at least one fillable FIELD. greenhouseFillFromPlan/greenhouseVerifyAnswers are vendor-blind despite the filename. Option harvest (2026-08-14) scrapes each control's real answer space from the LIVE page before planning: HTML alone cannot see a React-select's list, so dropdowns used to reach the planner empty and fall through to blind free-text typing.

key_files.src/ats/shared/preMutationGate.ts: verifyPageBeforeMutationGeneric (host/captcha/mismatch terminal; login wall and zero-field pages still fail the mutation lock)
key_files.src/ats/shared/requiredCompleteness.ts: refuse submit with unanswered required questions. Greenhouse React-select: skip empty filter inputs; committed value is .select__single-value, same as comboboxFill readback.
key_files.src/ats/shared/submitControl.ts: submit control resolve cascade; resolveAdvanceControl is Next/Continue (never the gated submit)
key_files.src/ats/registry.ts: adapter registry + HTML-based detection; last resort is generic, never a vendor-allowlist throw
key_files.src/ats/greenhouse/liveFill.ts: shared guarded live fill core; reachGreenhouseApplicationForm is the landing recovery submit reuses (SPA settle, iframe hop, Apply on a posting)
key_files.src/ats/workday/pageKind.ts: classifyWorkdayPage: auth checked BEFORE wizard (Create Account is step 1 of the wizard)
key_files.src/ats/generic/urlValidation.ts: https-only, never jobright, vendor-owned hosts rejected
key_files.src/ats/shared/optionHarvest.ts: harvestFieldOptions — opens each live control and scrapes its REAL option list before planning; classifies CLOSED (choose only) vs OPEN (type anything)
key_files.src/ats/shared/otherSpecify.ts: fillOtherSpecify — fills the free-text box a form reveals after "Other" is chosen
key_files.src/ats/shared/postingAdvance.ts: advancePastPosting — classify the landing; if it is a job posting, click Apply and look again (any ATS, bounded at 2 hops)
key_files.src/ats/shared/frameHop.ts: findApplicationFrameUrl — hop into an iframe whose document has fillable fields (https, or loopback http for the operator sandbox). Greenhouse embed/job_app URLs hop even when the child document is still empty/unreadable.
key_files.src/ats/shared/pageClassify.ts: classifyPage is the landing authority: password or emailed-code wall → auth, identity fields → form, Apply without identity → posting unless the URL path is already /apply, else unknown. Fill recovers from page_class, not the collapsed gate code.
key_files.src/ats/greenhouse/questionsApi.ts: fetchGreenhouseQuestions — the board's PUBLIC JSON declares every question and its COMPLETE option list; authoritative answer space, one request, fail-open to the DOM harvest
key_files.src/ats/ashby/discovery.ts: ashbyDiscoverFields — generic pass + radiogroup pass + fieldset question groups (question-title label + per-option inputs → ONE field with options[]; per-option fields suppressed)

nodes.label: Fill & submit engine
nodes.purpose: planApplicationFill builds a fill plan from discovered fields + profile + screener bank; toApprovedFillPlan freezes it; values come ONLY from the approved plan. runAtsLiveFill drives the live page (gate -> portal auth -> plan -> fill -> verify -> upload); --submit is loopback/sandbox only and still requires SUBMIT_ENABLED + confirmation. runAtsSubmission is the layered employer submit path: flags + approved entry + idempotency + completeness + confirmation seam.

key_files.src/applications/atsLiveFill.ts: live fill orchestrator; branches on classifyPage (auth→portal auth, posting→Apply, unknown→park); Workday Apply Manually still owned by portalAuth; loopback-only --submit
key_files.src/applications/resolveAnswers.ts: buildFillPlan: profile, screeners, consent checkboxes, demographics-from-sensitive-profile
key_files.src/applications/submitRun.ts: runAtsSubmission — greenhouse landing recovery then identity gate; same-run --submit reuses the filled page (no cold re-fill); click gate + unattended budget consumption
key_files.src/applications/fieldDiscovery.ts: discoverFieldsFromHtml (also the pre-mutation gate's field count)
key_files.src/applications/genericFormAdvance.ts: walkGenericFormPages — after a passing generic fill, click Next/Continue (never Submit), re-plan, fill; bounded
key_files.src/applications/essayAutofill.ts: essay generate-and-fill from about-me (ESSAY_AUTOFILL_ENABLED or SCREENER_PREDICT_LLM_ENABLED; validateDraft-checked)
key_files.src/applications/screenerOptionSelect.ts: LLM chooses from the page's own options, validated verbatim

nodes.label: Candidate data & screeners
nodes.purpose: Public profile (plain JSON), encrypted sensitive profile (EEO/demographics fill ONLY from here), screener answer bank with deterministic label->key->answer->verbatim-option resolution. LLM predict fills unmapped screeners and remembers the pair; EEO never takes that path.

key_files.src/candidate/screenerMatch.ts: deterministic screener resolution; polarity-safe option matching

nodes.label: Portal auth & email verification
nodes.purpose: Deterministic ATS portal sign-in/create-account with standing PORTAL_LOGIN_* credentials (any https employer host once set). Workday walk: Apply -> Apply Manually -> WAIT for the SPA to render the account form (bounded 15s). Email verification codes come from Gmail (web scan) or Outlook providers; secrets ride memory only.

key_files.src/verification/portalAuth.ts: authenticateAtsPortal — sign-in first, create on rejection

nodes.label: Gmail (read-only) & Outlook (drafts-only)
nodes.purpose: Gmail is READ-ONLY (readonlyGuards bans mutating identifiers); used for verification codes. Outlook creates DRAFTS only — sendGuards.ts is the banned-identifier source enforced by scripts/check-forbidden.ts. Mail is never sent by this system.

nodes.label: Contacts & outreach tail
nodes.purpose: Post-submit: extract insider contacts, rank, generate a referral email (LLM, deterministically re-validated), create an Outlook draft. Never sends.

key_files.src/contacts/emailGenerate.ts: LLM email generation + validation; COMPLETED apps still generate (no state rewind)

nodes.label: Pipeline driver
nodes.purpose: runPipeline steps ONE application through the state machine: materials -> navigation -> ATS detection -> inspection -> fill -> submit, stopping on review/terminal/gate. Every stop writes a review item or a state reason. Halt check ignores advisory review items. Fill with no stored employer URL and NAVIGATION_ENABLED returns to APPLICATION_OPENING instead of parking.

key_files.src/pipeline/runPipeline.ts: the step() switch over states; wall routing; portal-auth handoff for needs_login routes

nodes.label: L3 automation (armed sessions)
nodes.purpose: Arm session = automation_runs row (stage l3_session) with TTL + atomic submit budget; disarm/restart is fail-closed by construction. Worker loop: sweeps (URL audit, nav requeue, unsupported-ATS revival) -> discover -> per-app runPipeline with submit while budget lasts -> outreach tail. auto:cycle is the operator-desktop scheduled entry.

key_files.src/automation/artifactAutopush.ts: ARTIFACT_AUTOPUSH_ENABLED git push of run artifacts
key_files.src/automation/skipRequests.ts: requestSkip — cooperative operator skip; runPipeline reads it between steps so a stuck job can be abandoned at a safe boundary
key_files.src/automation/extensionPreflight.ts: extension presence probes (CDP target scan + DOM markers); verdict present|unknown, never confident absent

nodes.label: Operator console
nodes.purpose: Local web UI (frontend/ builds into it). RunManager spawns child runs with a flag CEILING — a child can never hold a flag the process `.env` lacks; unattended submit env only for armed automation runs. Confirmation seam for one-shot submits.

nodes.label: CLI
nodes.purpose: All operator commands (discover, inspect, fill, submit, pipeline, verify, screeners, accounts, viz). docs/operator-guide.md is the operator contract — update it when CLI behavior changes.

nodes.label: Dashboard, recorder, healer
nodes.purpose: Read-only dashboard; recorder captures live pages into sanitized fixtures; submit-inventory healer proposes (never applies) selector fixes. Heal loops are attempt-capped (house rule).

nodes.label: Employer sandbox
nodes.purpose: A fake employer on the operator's OWN machine (loopback only), driven by the real pipeline with the operator's real presets. /gauntlet = weird-questions application (predictive tiers, incl. odd questions from live artifacts in both CLOSED and OPEN classes); /portal = posting → email/password wall → form (posting advance + portalAuth account creation/sign-in). Page hits, fill-plan lines (with model rationale via POST /trace), and received submissions echo to the sandbox terminal + artifacts/sandbox/. Generic URL validation and portal-auth host recognition carry narrow loopback-only allowances so ats:fill --url http://localhost:4599/… drives it. ats:fill --submit is loopback-only and still requires SUBMIT_ENABLED + confirmation. 2026-08-16: /portal gained an emailed-code wall (random 6-digit per issue, newest wins) so the Gmail mailbox-scan recovery rehearses end to end; /navhard and /fillhard re-create the exact obstacles live artifacts show the nav and fill systems struggling with.

key_files.src/sandbox/server.ts: startEmployerSandbox — zero-dependency HTTP server, binds 127.0.0.1 only
key_files.src/sandbox/trace.ts: postSandboxTrace — ats:fill posts plan/rationale to the sandbox terminal (loopback only)
key_files.src/cli/sandboxCli.ts: npm run sandbox — start + print the drive-it recipes
key_files.src/sandbox/hardPages.ts: HARD courses: /navhard (cookie banner, decoys, late-settling popup, Paycom-shape lead-capture modal) and /fillhard (iframe wizard, virtualized combobox, pre-filled wrong value, error banner)
key_files.src/sandbox/email.ts: deliverVerificationCode — Resend-backed verification-code mail to the OPERATOR's own inbox (RESEND_API_KEY + SANDBOX_VERIFY_TO/PORTAL_LOGIN_EMAIL; console fallback); codes only, never outreach

flags.$comment: Capability flags. ALL default false (fail-closed); enabled in the operator's `.env` for a guarded run. The console ceiling (src/console/flagCeiling.ts) can only narrow, never widen.
flags.DRY_RUN: true = describe, never mutate (must be false to fill live)
flags.SUBMIT_ENABLED: the submit click (plus approved plan entry + confirmation/arm)
flags.NAVIGATION_ENABLED: click Apply on JobRight, portal auth, employer navigation
flags.CDP_AUTOLAUNCH_ENABLED: self-start the debug Chrome when :9222 is down
flags.GMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED: read-only Gmail scan for verification codes
flags.OUTLOOK_DRAFTS_ENABLED: create Outlook drafts (send is impossible by construction)
flags.GMAIL_DRAFTS_ENABLED: create Gmail drafts via the signed-in web session (Send is a forbidden selector, never clicked)
flags.SCREENER_LLM_MATCH_ENABLED: LLM places a HELD answer onto the page's own option list (verbatim-validated)
flags.SCREENER_PREDICT_LLM_ENABLED: plan-time screener prediction (fills + remembers custom bank entries; EEO excluded)
flags.ESSAY_AUTOFILL_ENABLED: essays generated from about-me.md fill directly (also unlocked by SCREENER_PREDICT_LLM_ENABLED; validateDraft-checked, recorded on the plan)
flags.ARTIFACT_AUTOPUSH_ENABLED: git-push run artifacts for the improvement loop

invariants: Every mutation capability is behind a fail-closed env flag; never defaulted on, never enabled in tests.
Form values come only from the approved plan (assertExecutableApprovedEntry is never weakened).
Demographics fill ONLY from the operator's encrypted sensitive profile; nothing inferred.
Mail is never sent: Outlook drafts only; sendGuards + check:forbidden enforce it.
State transitions only via the state machine; SQLite is the source of truth.
Selectors live in versioned registries, not inline.
Congruence (hostname vs company) is recorded evidence, never a proceed/stop gate (operator directive 2026-08-14).
The generic adapter has no flag: any https non-vendor employer form is fillable; mutation still behind the fill flags.
An agent's self-report carries no validation level until independently verified (validation ladder).
